description: Privileged access to Zen's Space and tab internals.

functions.name: describe
functions.description: Report versions and which Zen internals this build actually exposes.

functions.name: snapshot
functions.description: Enumerate every window, Space, and tab, including tabs in Spaces that are not visible and tabs that have not been loaded.

functions.name: openTab
functions.description: Open a tab in the background, optionally routed into an explicit Space. Never selects the tab or switches the visible Space.

functions.name: moveTab
functions.description: Route an existing tab into an explicit Space. Preserves the tab's identifier and does not switch the visible Space.

functions.name: navigateTab
functions.description: Navigate the tab with this identifier. Does not select it.

functions.name: reloadTab
functions.description: Reload the tab with this identifier. Does not select it.

functions.name: inspectPage
functions.description: Read bounded metadata and visible text from the loaded HTTP(S) document in the tab with this identifier. Does not select it.

functions.name: snapshotPage
functions.description: Capture a bounded semantic snapshot from an explicit loaded HTTP(S) tab without selecting it.

functions.name: queryPage
functions.description: Query one frame of a live semantic page snapshot.

functions.name: clickPage
functions.description: Click an explicit live element reference with a targeted DOM operation.

functions.name: fillPage
functions.description: Replace the value of an explicit editable element without focusing it.

functions.name: typePage
functions.description: Append text to an explicit editable element without focusing it.

functions.name: pressPage
functions.description: Dispatch a bounded key operation to an explicit element without native input or focus.

functions.name: selectPage
functions.description: Select explicit values in an explicit select element.

functions.name: checkPage
functions.description: Set an explicit checkbox or radio element to checked.

functions.name: uncheckPage
functions.description: Set an explicit checkbox element to unchecked.

functions.name: submitPage
functions.description: Submit the form associated with an explicit element reference.

functions.name: uploadPage
functions.description: Assign daemon-validated staged paths to an explicit file input without opening a picker.

functions.name: listPageMedia
functions.description: List bounded media metadata and accessible caption cues in one explicit frame.

functions.name: fetchPageMedia
functions.description: Fetch bounded same-origin non-DRM bytes for an explicit media element.

functions.name: fetchPageResource
functions.description: Fetch a bounded same-origin HTTP(S) resource with the page's credentials and no redirects.

functions.name: screenshotPage
functions.description: Capture an explicit frame viewport or element via parent-process drawSnapshot without activation.

functions.name: backPage
functions.description: Navigate an explicit tab back after validating its document generation.

functions.name: forwardPage
functions.description: Navigate an explicit tab forward after validating its document generation.

functions.name: closeTab
functions.description: Close the tab with this identifier.

events.name: onChanged
events.description: Fires when tabs change. Advisory only: a client that misses one must reconcile with a fresh snapshot.
